notes.title: New language + bug fixing
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we've just added simplified Chinese to the game, expanding our potential audience.

We're currently thinking about adding more languages to make the game more accessible.

In the meantime, we've also fixed a few minor bugs and display problems. We continue to strive for the best and most stable Swarm Survivor experience possible.

Thanks to all those who play Swarm Survivor, it means a lot to us, as it is our first game.

More and more of you are enjoying the game, and this motivates us to keep improving it and pushing it further.

Happy Halloween.

-The Swarm Survivor team

notes.title: Update 1: Bugfixes / Quality of life
notes.content:
Here is what this first small update holds:

[b]- Gadgets behavior should be more consistent.[/b] You will no longer throw molotovs into the void.
[b]- Boss projectiles will be destroyed if they hit you.[/b] A single projectile will no longer be able to hit you multiple times.
[b]- Multiple small fixes and tweaks.
[/b]
We are working on more bugfixes, QoL changes and visual polish as we speak.

notes.title: V1.0 RELEASE
notes.content:
Swarm Survivor is now available all around the world !

Venture into the shadows, kill the boss and try to escape !

Unlock new perks, heavy weapons and abilities that will help you survive the increasingly menacing monsters.

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SwarmSurvivor]Twitter[/url] to stay up to date with the last announcements and updates.

notes.title: First Playtest is now open!
notes.content:
With our first playtest we aim to gather a lot of feedback from the players, to help us finish the game properly. This build of the game is still heavily [b]WIP[/b] even if it is entirely playable.

Menus in particular still need a lot of love.

We hope you will enjoy your time with Swarm Survivor, thanks again!
